signature: generateSentence(uint16[] prompt,uint8 maximumNewTokens) returns(uint16[] tokens,bool endedEos,bool endedSentence,bytes32 lastLogitHash)
stopping: Stop only after the model predicts a native terminator or EOS; reaching the token cap reports both ending flags false.
limitations: Punctuation is a stopping condition, not a grammar or factual-quality guarantee. All generated tokens and the final full-vocabulary hash must be checked against the independent model reference.
